description: Full-scope reference graph. A real mission selects applicable nodes and must prove every selected predecessor and manual/external gate independently.
edge_semantics: predecessor committed verified receipt before successor eligible; edge does not imply grant or automatic dispatch

nodes.label: Capture scoped source or offline handover
nodes.evidence: Source/session identity, scope, data-access authorization

nodes.label: Pin Drive revision or Git commit and actual digest
nodes.evidence: Provider ID/revision or Git SHA/blob IDs; actual bytes

nodes.label: Validate GMI schema, paths, idempotency
nodes.evidence: Fail-closed, source-bound validation receipt

nodes.label: Approve proposal-profile contract policy #44
nodes.evidence: Recorded owner decision and compatibility fixtures

nodes.label: Code plan and typed contract review
nodes.evidence: Source-bound CODEX worker receipt

nodes.label: Runtime and first-red negative QA
nodes.evidence: Source-bound ABACUS QA receipt

nodes.label: Numerical and confidence validation
nodes.evidence: Source-bound gg_MATH proof receipt

nodes.label: Document and visual QA when in scope
nodes.evidence: Source-bound binary QA receipt

nodes.label: Join required committed child receipts
nodes.evidence: All selected predecessors signed off; hashes and exclusivity verified

nodes.label: Open source-pinned draft PR
nodes.evidence: Branch/ref, patch digest, recorded proposal status

nodes.label: Native CI and negative checks on exact PR head
nodes.evidence: Nonzero steps, required checks, exact SHA

nodes.label: Independent review of final PR head
nodes.evidence: Completed review after last push, review SHA

nodes.label: Authorize governed merge without RED waiver
nodes.evidence: Effective protection/canary evidence and explicit owner disposition

nodes.label: Observe merged SHA and post-merge checks
nodes.evidence: Real protected target ref and merge SHA readback

nodes.label: Configure restricted OIDC WIF, service account and vars #12
nodes.evidence: Observed cloud trust and repo configuration; no key

nodes.label: Viewer ACL on approved IC3 Drive root only
nodes.evidence: Approved root ID and Viewer grant

nodes.label: Hosted read-only IC3 >0-step census
nodes.evidence: Exact run/job/SHA, scope, result and deterministic census

nodes.label: Authorize separate Drive writer and new-version policy
nodes.evidence: Explicit writer scope; no implication from read-only IC3

nodes.label: Publish new version and verify readback
nodes.evidence: New revision, content SHA and pointer reconciliation

nodes.label: Consumer-domain acceptance if scoped
nodes.evidence: Consumer-specific DoV; QPS authority never inherited
